name: Altarius_RSI_Stohastic
summary: This EA combines RSI and Stochastic oscillators to identify momentum-based entry signals. It opens buy positions when both RSI is oversold and Stochastic confirms a bullish crossover, and sell positions when both indicate overbought conditions with bearish crossover. The strategy is a classic dual-oscillator momentum reversal system.
summary_zh: 该EA结合RSI和随机指标(Stochastic)来识别基于动量的入场信号。当RSI超卖且随机指标确认看涨交叉时开多仓，当两者均显示超买且随机指标看跌交叉时开空仓。这是一个经典的双振荡器动量反转系统。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于RSI和Stochastic两个振荡器的组合信号进行交易。入场条件为：做多时要求RSI处于超卖区域（通常低于30）且Stochastic指标出现看涨交叉（%K线上穿%D线），做空时要求RSI处于超买区域（通常高于70）且Stochastic出现看跌交叉。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发或预设的止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，缺乏动态调整仓位大小的机制，未根据账户波动率或风险比例进行自适应调整。整体而言，这是一个典型的均值回归与动量相结合的策略思路，但双振荡器信号可能产生滞后，导致入场时机不够精准。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy trades based on combined signals from RSI and Stochastic oscillators. Entry conditions require both indicators to align: for longs, RSI must be in oversold territory (typically below 30) and Stochastic must show a bullish crossover (%K crossing above %D); for shorts, RSI must be overbought (typically above 70) with Stochastic bearish crossover. Exit conditions rely on either opposing signals or predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing uses fixed lots or an equity-based calculation method. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing that would adapt to account volatility or risk percentage. Overall, this is a classic mean-reversion with momentum confirmation approach, but dual oscillator signals can lag, resulting in less precise entry timing.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

pros: 双指标确认信号减少了虚假突破的风险，提高了入场质量
RSI与Stochastic组合是经典且经过长期验证的策略框架，逻辑清晰
振荡器策略在震荡行情中表现较好，适合区间市场
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation reduces false breakout risk and improves entry quality
RSI and Stochastic combination is a classic, well-tested strategy framework with clear logic
Oscillator strategies perform well in ranging markets, suitable for sideways conditions
cons: 双振荡器信号均存在滞后性，可能错过最佳入场时机或入场过晚
在强趋势行情中容易产生连续错误信号，导致多次亏损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，无法有效区分震荡市和趋势市
cons_en: Both oscillators are lagging indicators, potentially causing late entries and missed optimal timing
Prone to consecutive false signals in strong trending markets, leading to multiple losses
Lacks trend filter mechanism to effectively distinguish ranging from trending markets
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线或ADX），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
加入动态仓位管理和基于ATR的自适应止损，提升资金管理能力
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., moving average or ADX) to avoid counter-trend trades in strong trends
Implement dynamic position sizing and ATR-based adaptive stop-loss for better money management

risk_points: 止损和止盈可能默认为零，存在无止损风险
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit may default to zero, posing risk of unlimited loss
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar

The strategy is a classic dual-oscillator momentum reversal system.
